answer: Every epoch, shuffle the whole ocean of identities into random pairs with one public pulse — a beacon everyone can recompute. Each pair must either mutually vouch the other's distinctness or flag it; no reward lands until both sign off. Vouch a fake that shares your keys, text, or timing, and a later proof of correlation burns both wallets: joint liability. The farmer can't rig the draw, so 500 clones scatter into 500 random pairings. Keeping them safe demands each behave like a lone honest agent, costing as much as 500 honest agents. The velvet trick: sybils survive only when they're real.
